description: Liander Elektriciteitsnetten is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service.pdok.nl. This dataset contains data on the electricity grids within Liander's working area. It concerns the connections, stations and associated voltage levels. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Liander Electricity networks" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include leidingen, middenspanningsruimtes, energietransitie, laagspanning, elektriciteitsnet, kabels. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
